channel.title: Morning Gas & Energy Brief
channel.description: Phil's weekday morning brief: North American natural gas, Alberta weather and Lower-48 degree days, energy M&A, and geopolitics. Generated and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Phil

item.title: Tue Sep 22 — Stocks at records as oil plunges
item.description: Nasdaq record on Meta's AI surge; WTI drops to low 0s on Saudi supply rebound; gas under .85; BoC October hike odds ~60%.

item.title: Mon Sep 21 — Gas holds $2.90 as oil exhales under $100
item.description: Deep gas: HH ~$2.91 as LNG pull blunts cooler forecasts; storage surplus narrows to ~118 Bcf; record 113.1 Bcf/d supply; WTI under $100, TTF below EUR 80 on de-escalation into UNGA week.

item.title: Fri Sep 18 — Stocks rally after Fed hike; lean 44 Bcf build
item.description: Post-hike relief rally, +44 Bcf storage vs 74 avg, Cameron LNG maintenance, Saudi pipeline repair, Calgary's $130M surplus vs 20% tax ask.

item.title: Thu Sep 17 — Lean storage build expected; Fed hikes
item.description: Storage day: consensus +47-49 Bcf vs 74 five-year avg; Henry Hub coils under $2.90; production slides; Fed's first hike since 2023.

item.title: Wed Sep 16 — Fed decision day: first hike in three years expected
item.description: Fed poised for 25bp hike at noon MT with the 10-year at 5%; WTI above $103 as Saudi East-West stays down; gas holds $2.91; WCS discount widens on Joliet outage.

item.title: Tue Sep 15 — Fed opens meeting, first hike in three years looms
item.description: 93% odds of a 25bp hike Wednesday; 10-year at 5%; Brent $106 with Saudi East-West pipeline offline; gas .89 on 19.6 Bcf/d feedgas; NDP upset in Calgary-Shaw.

item.title: Mon Sep 14 — Gas rebounds on record feedgas, warm shift
item.description: Oct Henry Hub +2.5% to $2.89 on 19.6 Bcf/d feedgas and a warmer CPC outlook; Fed hike week, ~90% odds.

item.title: Thu Sep 10 — Gas breaks down into storage day
item.description: Henry Hub slides 6% on cooler 10-15 day models into an EIA print with no consensus; TTF near 4-year highs, Brent above $100 as the tanker war widens.

item.title: Wed Sep 9 — Oil at the door of one hundred as US-Iran tanker war escalates
item.description: Brent tops $100 on US strikes on Iranian tankers; stocks fall a third day; Canada's tariffs take effect; gas quiet under $2.90 with TTF at new highs; Calgary budget leak and Green Line route pick.

item.title: Tue Sep 8 — Gas coiled under $3 as TTF hits 3.5-year high
item.description: Holiday reopen: HH flat near 2-month highs; storage math ahead of Thursday; TTF record run, WTI ~$94 on Jazan strike and Hormuz corridor talk.

item.title: Mon Sep 7 — Jobs shock puts Fed hike in play
item.description: Labour Day broad brief: US +162K jobs vs Canada −42K, Fed hike coin flip, OPEC+ holds, gas near , Calgary rain.

item.title: Fri Sep 4 — Jobs day meets a coin-flip Fed
item.description: August payrolls at 8:30 ET with Fed odds at 50/50 after Waller; stocks' best day in a month; oil's biggest weekly gain since July; gas +30 Bcf in-line, October's $3 breakout fizzles.

item.title: Thu Sep 3 — Gas at 8-week high into storage day
item.description: Henry Hub near .94 into the EIA print (~28 Bcf expected); feedgas rebounds past 18 Bcf/d; Hormuz keeps Brent near 7; OPEC+ Sunday.

item.title: Wed Sep 2 — US-Iran war day two, Brent near 96
item.description: US strikes IRGC targets, Iran hits back at Jordan and Bahrain; Brent ~$96, 10-yr at post-2023 high; TTF +130% y/y; gas chops at $2.95; HH storage print Thursday.
